# Where the numbers come from

::: {.callout-note}
Revised with assistance from OpenAI Codex/GPT-6. Earlier skeleton drafted by Claude Code/Fable 5.1. This summary remains unfinished.
:::

The draft technical report documents the data, models and checks, following a Bayesian workflow [@mcelreathStatisticalRethinkingBayesian2020].

The [project repository](https://github.com/dseinternational/vocabulary-growth) records source data, model definitions and analysis code. The [model inventory](https://github.com/dseinternational/vocabulary-growth/blob/main/docs/models/README.md) states which model supplies each reported quantity. This draft reads the fitted output recorded as `{python} generated_from()`.

Quote the model, fit date and output version when citing a numerical estimate. A refit can change the numbers. Published pages need a deliberate update and validation; the prediction-pack export and interactive chart integration are still unfinished.
